purpose: Teach: 高圧/無秩序/慈悲/漂流/召喚/同化/戒め/惨事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に高圧的な指導は絶対にするな
lines.en: Never use harsh, high-handed instruction with our staff. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Emphasis on 「絶対に」—flat, final. No room for discussion. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone stating a principle, not a preference.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の無秩序状況にも備えております
lines.en: Understood. We're already prepared for market instability.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation, slightly faster pace. Clipped efficiency. Not defensive—just stating readiness. The response of someone who's thought ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への慈悲の心を忘れるな
lines.en: And don't forget—compassion for our valued clients is foundational to who we are.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate than the first line. Weight on 「慈悲の心」—almost teaching. Quiet conviction. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外プロジェクトの漂流を防ぎます
lines.en: Yes. We're actively preventing scope creep on the overseas initiative.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving cadence. Competent and calm. Slight upward lift at the end—a reassurance without seeking approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、関係者を緊急で召喚しろ
lines.en: Call in the relevant stakeholders immediately. That's urgent.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. No softening. Sharp attack on the first word. The tempo picks up slightly—action-oriented.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。買収先との同化過程を慎重に進めます
lines.en: Understood. We have contingency plans in place for worst-case scenarios.
lines.style: Steady, professional closure. Slightly lower in register—reassuring without boasting. Even pacing. The kind of reply that settles a room.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、過去の失敗を戒めとして次に活かせ
lines.en: Learn from past failures. Turn them into wisdom for what comes next.
lines.style: Gravitas in the opening. Pause after 「失敗を戒めとして」—letting it land. Thoughtful, almost reflective. The voice of someone who's lived through setbacks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大惨事に備えた事業継続計画を整備しております
lines.en: Yes. We've built our business continuity protocols to handle major disruption.
lines.style: Closing statement—solid, complete. Calm, professional confidence. No hesitation. The final word trails slightly lower—a period, not a question.
